test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Can you please pass me that glittery pen black?
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**glittery pen black?**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The mistake is in the **ordering of the adjectives**.
 
• The correct order is opinion, size, age, shape, colour, origin, material, purpose.
 
• "Colour" should come before "quality" or "opinion," according to the arrangement.
 
• In this case, "**glittery**" is an opinion, "**black**" is a colour, so the correct order would be "**black glittery pen**."
 
• The correct sentence would be "Can you please pass me that glittery black pen?"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
